candidate_pool_control: All sequence variants within a document consume the same semantically eligible hypothesis pool; OCR and matching are fixed.

combined_descriptive.interpretation: Descriptive pooling of two record-disjoint deterministic cohorts; no population sampling weights are available.

limitations: Semantic eligibility is part of candidate construction and cannot be removed while keeping the candidate pool identical.
The semantic ablation removes only the geology-term node-score bonus.
The California candidate pool contains one RapidOCR reader, so multi-reader agreement is not independently ablatable.
These variants identify contributions of sequence scoring components, not causal effects of all geological constraints in the full project.
reproduction_gate: complete_sequence boundary sets exactly reproduce every archived constrained prediction
source: archived RapidOCR positioned regions from California v004/v005

variants.candidate_pool_without_sequence: all semantically eligible positioned hypotheses, ordered and deduplicated
variants.column_stable_without_semantic_bonus: continuity plus column-stability penalty, excluding the geology-term node bonus
variants.complete_sequence: column-stable sequence plus geology-term node bonus
variants.continuity_sequence: monotonic sequence plus adjacent-boundary continuity score
variants.monotonic_sequence: node scores plus document order and nondecreasing depth
